# Mock CDR PKI

## Library specifications

None.

## Certificates

The rules of PKI-0001 and PKI-0002 apply to each certificate.

- <a id="pki-0001"></a>**PKI-0001** The CDR CA signs each client certificate. ([CP section 6][accc-cp])
- <a id="pki-0002"></a>**PKI-0002** The CDR CA signs each server certificate, as [PKI-0001](#pki-0001) says. ([CP section 6][accc-cp])

## Withdrawn

None.
